title: Dual GLB Character Synchronized Dance Choreography
prompt:
Create a single HTML file using Three.js (via CDN) that loads two GLB models and choreographs them in a synchronized dance routine driven by a configurable beat tempo.

## Scene Setup
- Use a perspective camera at position (0, 3, 8) looking at origin.
- Add a ground plane (20x20, dark gray #222222) at y=0 with receiveShadow.
- Add ambient light (intensity 0.4) and a directional light at (5, 10, 5) with castShadow enabled, intensity 1.0.
- Set renderer background to #1a1a2e. Enable shadows on the renderer.

## Model Loading
- Load 'IridescenceAbalone.glb' using GLTFLoader. Place it at position (-2, 0, 0). This is Character A (left dancer).
- Load 'DragonDispersion.glb' using GLTFLoader. Place it at position (2, 0, 0). This is Character B (right dancer).
- Scale both models uniformly so they each fit within a 2-unit bounding box height. Compute bounding boxes after load and normalize.
- After both models are loaded, set window.__3D_STATE__.modelsLoaded = true.

## Beat System
- Maintain a BPM (beats per minute) value, default 120.
- Compute beatInterval = 60 / BPM in seconds.
- Track a running beatCount starting at 0. Every time the elapsed time crosses a beat boundary, increment beatCount by 1.
- Store the current beat phase (0.0 to 1.0) within each beat interval as beatPhase.
- The beat system should run only when playing (not paused).

## Dance Choreography
- Define 4 dance moves: 'sway', 'bounce', 'spin', 'lean'.
- The current move changes every 4 beats (so every 4 * beatInterval seconds).
- The move index cycles: 0=sway, 1=bounce, 2=spin, 3=lean, then repeats.
- Character A and Character B perform the SAME move simultaneously but MIRRORED:
  - 'sway': Both rotate on Y axis sinusoidally. A rotates +sin(beatPhase * 2PI) * 0.3 rad, B rotates -sin(beatPhase * 2PI) * 0.3 rad.
  - 'bounce': Both translate on Y axis. A: y_base + abs(sin(beatPhase * PI)) * 0.5. B: y_base + abs(sin(beatPhase * PI)) * 0.5 (same, not mirrored on Y).
  - 'spin': Both rotate on Y axis continuously. A: beatPhase * 2PI. B: -beatPhase * 2PI (opposite direction).
  - 'lean': Both rotate on Z axis. A: sin(beatPhase * 2PI) * 0.4 rad. B: -sin(beatPhase * 2PI) * 0.4 rad.
- Store the current move name in state.

## Controls
- Play/Pause button (id='btn-play-pause', text toggles 'Play'/'Pause'). Starts in paused state with text 'Play'.
- BPM slider (id='bpm-slider', range 60-200, step 1, default 120) with a label showing current BPM (id='bpm-label').
- A 'Reset' button (id='btn-reset') that resets beatCount to 0, moveIndex to 0, elapsed time to 0, and pauses playback.
- A beat indicator div (id='beat-indicator') that flashes bright (background #ff6600) on each beat hit and fades back to #333333 over the beat interval.

## HUD
- Display current BPM, beatCount, current move name, and playing status in a HUD overlay (id='hud') at top-left, white text on semi-transparent black background.

## State Management (window.__3D_STATE__)
Expose and continuously update:
- modelsLoaded: boolean
- isPlaying: boolean
- bpm: number (current BPM)
- beatCount: number (total beats elapsed)
- beatPhase: number (0.0-1.0 within current beat)
- currentMove: string ('sway'|'bounce'|'spin'|'lean')
- moveIndex: number (0-3)
- characterA_position: {x, y, z}
- characterA_rotation: {x, y, z} (Euler in radians)
- characterB_position: {x, y, z}
- characterB_rotation: {x, y, z} (Euler in radians)
- elapsedTime: number (seconds since play started, pauses when paused)
- beatInterval: number (seconds per beat)

All numeric values must be NaN-free at all times.
physics_constraints: Characters must remain mirrored in their dance moves (opposite sign on mirrored axes). Beat timing must be consistent with BPM. BeatPhase must always be in [0,1). ElapsedTime must be monotonically non-decreasing while playing and frozen while paused. All positions and rotations must be NaN-free.
